This proves equality in all dimensions, including repeated, zero and negative eigenvalues. Polynomial minors prove genericity; small kernel perturbations prove ambiguity among positive-definite candidates; geometric-spectrum counts yield the sharp ceil(n/2) budget. originality.rationale: The closest direct 2026 primary paper imposes a generic rank condition without solving the spectral-constrained design problem. Zhou 2016 proves the output-count lower bound for unrestricted linear output maps of a lifted system, but does not prove its sufficiency with each sensor restricted to a rank-one symmetric outer product of an actual initial state. The explicit simultaneous structured construction and full rank curve as trajectory count varies are not implications of the unrestricted statement alone. Other inspected works have different data regimes or inverse targets. Residual risk: an uncatalogued structured-output cyclicity result may already contain the theorem.
residual_risks: Classical generalized cyclicity with Veronese-constrained outputs or algebraic observability could subsume this constructive rank statement in an unindexed reference.
The motivating paper uses a known-model Riccati setting; this theorem concerns the free symmetric quadratic regression, not full model-constrained value-function identifiability.
The proof does not characterize joint optimization over horizons shorter than the number of distinct eigenvalue products.

value.rationale: The primary quadratic terminal-value fitting formulation needs independent quadratic regressors and expressly leaves how many new initial conditions are needed unresolved. The exact spectral-product multiplicity is an experimentally meaningful, computable sharp trajectory-count invariant; the stable distinct-eigenvalue geometric family shows a persistent rank deficit invisible to ordinary linear cyclicity. A direct nonnegative and constructive design is given. This is not only a rephrasing of generic d-sample counting, and its r-dependent rank formula quantifies partial information.
